The affix लट् (Present Tense) is used after a root when it has in composition with it the wordsअपि or जातु , the sense implied by the sentence being that of 'censure'.

Terms: लट्

The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) comes in all tenses when the words यच्च and यत्र are in composition with it, provided that censure is implied.

Terms: लिङ्

The affix यञ् comes in the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the words गर्ग etc.

Terms: यञ्

The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) denoting a place and having the word गर्त as its second term.

Terms: छ
